note: shift_flip(Param,mat,ratvec->bool): default-extension sign under rational gamma shift on SL(2,R)/SU(2,1)/SL(3,R)/SO(3,2), identity and diagram-flip deltas, integral and half-integral fixed gammas. All probed cases return false: no true case found in rank<=2 sweeps (~1300 oracle calls, KGB-wide on A2 split with nu in {[1,1],[2,2],[1,1]/2,[3,3]/2}); upstream uses shift_flip nowhere in scripts, and the ext_finalise 1s* flip arises from star finalisation, not plain shifts.
